newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway expands 12-month T-bill by NOK 3.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: Norway expands 12-month T-bill by NOK 3.0 bln.

text.p: Norway's Central Bank said on Thursday the Finance Ministry was expanding the SS43 treasury bill by three billion crowns.
The amount will be issued by ordinary auction with the final date for tenders on February 3. Settlement is two days later.
The 12-month T-bill has a nominal interest rate of 4.80 percent and matures on June 18, 1997.
The bank does not provide figures for the total amount of money issued in the bill, which was last expanded by three billion crowns on Agust 19.
